description: This file defines the NoteDetailActivity class, which manages creating, editing, and deleting individual notes within the app. It handles UI interactions, data retrieval, and database operations related to note details.

classes.name: NoteDetailActivity
classes.description: An activity that allows users to view, create, edit, and delete individual notes, managing UI components and database interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, retrieves note data if editing, and sets click listeners.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and adjusts menu item visibility based on whether editing an existing note.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the delete action.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves or updates the note in the database, providing user feedback via Toast.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog for deleting the current note, and deletes upon confirmation.
